results.name: Messages from a different extension are ignored
Meet policy uses Chrome sender metadata, not request URL
Lazy MediaPipe injected into the requesting document in ISOLATED world
Repeated library requests are deduplicated per document
Different document IDs receive their own libraries
Library whitelist rejects paths and prototype keys
Libraries cannot be injected without a calling tab
Injection denial is reported and can be retried
Navigation clears the per-document library cache
Active camera status produces an ON badge
Processing failure remains visible in diagnostics
